description: Ex-Armee de l'Air reconnaissance Mirage kept at the Chateau Pas de Loup, a wine estate and holiday property at Saix in the Tarn. Nicolas Pillet photographed the aircraft and its cockpit interior; his page was last updated on 10 July 2026. Private ground, so access is by arrangement with the owner.
museum_name: Mirage III, Château Pas de Loup, Saix
